source_facts: Fixed canonical stable Turn exposes optional/nullable startedAt and completedAt in Unix seconds and durationMs in milliseconds; app-server history builder preserves native turn event metadata.
Host nativeWireTurn and projectNativeTurn omit turn clock fields; Desktop generated NativeTurn uses deny_unknown_fields. Item durationMs is not turn duration.
Desktop scheduled query Timing only expresses not_started/unknown with no_execution_clock; records page renders these placeholders.
Existing owner-only native-thread-status demonstrates additive independent read projection. ReadThread issues stable thread/read with includeTurns=true and validates thread identity.
Desktop SQL reader maximum and ordinary migration target are separate; native formats 1/2 are strict and will remain unchanged.
Recovery candidates filter released runs; timing collection must separately cover bound terminal records without making timing a condition for reservation release.
decisions: Recommend only AC009 execution clock closure; no power, card action redesign, in-app updates or full D4.
Use independent readonly native-turn-timing family to keep current closed history DTO/SSE unchanged; Host remains stateless thin adapter.
Candidate SQL26 only after compatible reader; ordinary SQL15/Store5 and candidate Host6 remain; no daily DB.
Only exact scoped runtime bindings can accept clock fields; timestamps never grant execution or imply lifecycle terminal/release.
No UUID, scheduled time, local receive clock, Provider ledger, item duration or legacy reducer as execution time source.
Finite collection uses at most 50 local candidates, one RPC at once, three reads per attempt cycle with 1s/5s backoff and <=3s deadlines; no automatic immediate budget reset.
Initial fixed-runtime qualification reuses current SQL25 manual run, final SQL26 rerun uses the second and final declared local-provider request; zero paid calls.
Freeze shared source and generated consumers before candidate writer; verify directional compatibility and all registered baselines; no fabricated immutable pin.
unverified_until_implementation: Actual fixed runtime hot/cold turn clock availability via the proposed query; canonical field presence is not runtime execution evidence.
New contract, SQL26, bounded collection, UI and compatibility have not been implemented or tested.
Long-history thread/read can hit existing resource bounds; unknown must remain explicit without widening Runtime scope.
